reason: A memory and context plugin for DeepSeek Harness that manages a wiki-style linked memory graph, providing retrieval, page management, knowledge compilation, graph health checks, and optional resident subagent retrieval.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 wiki 双链图谱的记忆检索、页面管理、知识编译和图谱健康检查功能。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with wiki-style linked memory retrieval, page management, knowledge compilation, graph health checks, and optional resident subagent retrieval.

capabilities: Index and search configured local memory pages using full-text and optional vector retrieval
Read memory pages and scan wiki-style links
Create and delete memory pages in the configured write directory
Generate knowledge-page candidates and update previews for later confirmation
Check graph statistics, reachability, and dead links
Spawn and continue a resident retriever subagent when supported by the host environment
